== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 23 January 2021. The Facebook photo viewer names Alessio Filigenzi. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 109 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Rome, It). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/alessio.filigenzi and lists Lives in Rome, Italy. The uncropped original is a two-person selfie; Filigenzi is on the right (the same person appears in a later "Half-Century Achieved" photograph on the same profile). The lead crop is Filigenzi alone.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Alessio Filigenzi portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Alessio Filigenzi Facebook portrait.jpg]].
